title: Wine Wimsey Review · Thu Nov 12
subtitle: Batch date Thu Nov 12 (EVEN day): plain cards at queue positions 2,4,6,8,10; character posts at 1,3,5,7,9. 10 feed posts + 4 stories, volume/format test, no captions or first comments. Characters: Hot Mess 2 (#1, #7), Homebody 1 (#3), Settled One 1 (#5), Bold One 1 (#9); stories Settled One, Homebody, Hot Mess, Bold One. Seasonal: 4 of 10 feed (plain #2 Thanksgiving dietary guests, plain #4 good tablecloth; character #1 napkin turkeys, #3 family arrival time) plus story 1 (Thanksgiving playlist); Thanksgiving is Nov 26, so all work on the Nov 12 publish date. No weekday references. Inbox: no new items. Quote sourcing: 0 spun, 5 original plain cards, 5 original character quotes, 4 original story quotes. FLAGS: (1) Every FFF winner in the list had already been used (checked against the used log, 11-09 and 11-10 batches spun the last ones), so no spins this run; all plain cards are originals. (2) Credits: 9 images x ~45 = ~405; 5 plain cards free. (3) Image checks: every image viewed, every quote matches word for word. Minor: the clock in #3 reads about 2:45 instead of 9:15 (hard to notice), cats were added to #3 and #5 by the model, the Homebody in story 2 has a darker skin tone than in her other images.
